MATCH (p:Player)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team) WHERE t.team_name CONTAINS 'Cedevita Olimpija' AND EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document) } WITH p, t, CAST(SUBSTRING(p.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INT64) AS birth_year, CAST(SUBSTRING(p.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INT64) AS birth_month, CAST(SUBSTRING(p.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INT64) AS birth_day RETURN 2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, p.name AS name_player
